title.en: Su Shi: Exiled Again, Living as Dongpo
title.zh-CN: 苏轼：一贬再贬，过成东坡

shots.description: Night river in layered mist under a pale moon; one small boat with a seated figure seen from far away
shots.motion: slow push-in; title wipes in on beat 1; ripples drift

en.text: Huangzhou, Huizhou, then Changhua: exiled again and again.

zh-CN.text: 从黄州到惠州，再到昌化军，他一贬再贬。

shots.description: Close on xuan paper: a brush writes the two characters 东坡 in big strokes, then a cinnabar seal is pressed
shots.motion: strokes appear over beats 0-5; seal stamps on beat 6

en.text: The name of a field became his own.

zh-CN.text: 一块地的名字，后来成了他的名字。

shots.description: Misty Sichuan hills, terraced slopes and a small town of tiled roofs by a river
shots.motion: pan right across three depth layers; mist bands drift

en.text: The story begins in Meishan.

zh-CN.text: 故事从眉山开始。

shots.description: A handscroll unrolls on a desk beside an inkstone; plum blossoms grow on the scroll
shots.motion: scroll unrolls beats 0-3; plum grows beats 2-7

en.text: Born on 8 January 1037; courtesy name Zizhan.

zh-CN.text: 1037年1月8日，苏轼出生，字子瞻。

shots.description: Two robed scholars seen from behind walk toward a city gate under a wide sky
shots.motion: figures walk toward the gate; card appears on beat 1

en.text: In 1057 he and his brother passed the jinshi exam.

zh-CN.text: 1057年，他和弟弟一同进京赶考，考中进士。

shots.description: A lake city with willows, a causeway and a pavilion, painted in ink and indigo wash
shots.motion: parallax drift; willow tips sway

en.text: In 1071 he went to Hangzhou as vice-prefect.

zh-CN.text: 1071年，他到杭州出任通判。

shots.description: A walled city with a river bursting its banks; small silhouettes carry earth to the wall
shots.motion: water lines surge on beat 0 and beat 4; figures move

en.text: In Xuzhou the Yellow River burst; he joined the flood relief.

zh-CN.text: 在徐州，黄河决口，他亲自参加救灾。

shots.description: An official letter on the desk; a seal is pressed onto it
shots.motion: push-in; seal stamps on beat 4

en.text: In 1079 he became prefect of Huzhou. And then?

zh-CN.text: 1079年，他移知湖州。接下来呢？

shots.description: Heavy ink bars of a cell, a single candle flickering behind them
shots.motion: bars slam in on beat 0; candle flickers

en.text: Records say he was jailed that year and nearly died.

zh-CN.text: 据记载，同年他因乌台诗案入狱，几乎丧命。

shots.description: Detail: a writing brush lying on the floor in the candlelight
shots.motion: ink drop spreads from the brush tip on beat 1

en.text: What would you do now?

zh-CN.text: 换作是你，此刻会怎么想？

shots.description: A small official boat leaves a city gate at dawn on a grey river
shots.motion: boat glides right; mist rises

en.text: Spared, he was demoted to Huangzhou.

zh-CN.text: 他免于一死，被贬为黄州团练副使。

shots.description: A hillside field east of a riverside town; a robed farmer in a straw hat hoes the slope (silhouette)
shots.motion: pan left; hoe strokes on beats 2 and 6; card appears on beat 1

en.text: In 1080, in Huangzhou, he farmed a plot of land.

zh-CN.text: 1080年，他来到黄州，躬耕一块地。

shots.description: The four characters 东坡居士 written vertically, a seal beside them
shots.motion: characters reveal beats 0-4; seal on the card beat

en.text: He named it Dongpo, and himself Dongpo Jushi.

zh-CN.text: 他把它命名为东坡，自号东坡居士。

shots.description: Fishing boats and a woodcutter on a river bank; a scholar sits among them by a small fire
shots.motion: parallax; nets cast on beat 2; smoke rises

en.text: He roamed hills and rivers with fishermen and woodcutters.

zh-CN.text: 他放浪山水之间，与渔樵杂处。

shots.description: The same field at dusk seen from above the river, the farmer small in the frame
shots.motion: pull-out; geese cross on beat 4

en.text: Huangzhou was home from 1080 to 1084.

zh-CN.text: 他在黄州，从1080年住到1084年。

shots.description: Red cliffs over a moonlit river with a small boat below
shots.motion: pan right; moon glints on beat 4

en.text: Records say in 1082 he wrote the First Ode on the Red Cliff.
em: First Ode on the Red Cliff

zh-CN.text: 据记载，1082年他游赤壁，写下《前赤壁赋》。

shots.description: A lone traveller on a northern road in autumn wind
shots.motion: push-in; leaves blow across

en.text: In 1084 he left Huangzhou for Ruzhou.

zh-CN.text: 1084年，他离开黄州，改任汝州。

shots.description: Southern banana leaves and a monastery roof in humid haze
shots.motion: leaves sway; card appears on beat 1

en.text: In 1094 he was exiled again, to Huizhou.

zh-CN.text: 1094年，他又被贬到惠州。

shots.description: Open sea with a single sail and a distant coastline (no borders), long horizon
shots.motion: waves roll; sail drifts left; card on beat 1

en.text: In 1097 he was placed under watch in Changhua.

zh-CN.text: 1097年，他被安置在昌化军。

shots.description: A coastal harbour in morning light; boats raise sails and head north
shots.motion: sails rise on beats 2 and 4

en.text: In 1100 his place of exile moved to Lianzhou.

zh-CN.text: 1100年，他的贬所移到廉州。

shots.description: An old scholar seen from behind, standing on a river bank looking north
shots.motion: push-in toward the horizon; wind in the robe

en.text: Would the road north ever open?

zh-CN.text: 北归的路，会不会就此打开？

shots.description: Abstract ink terrain with rivers (no borders); a cinnabar route draws through his postings
shots.motion: route draws from beat 0 to beat 13; each stop pops as the brush reaches it

en.text: Hangzhou, Mizhou, Xuzhou, Huzhou, Huangzhou, Huizhou, Changhua.

zh-CN.text: 杭州、密州、徐州、湖州、黄州、惠州、昌化军。

shots.description: A quiet riverside house at dusk with a single lamp in the window
shots.motion: lamp glows, then dims at the end of the shot

en.text: In 1101 he died in Changzhou.

zh-CN.text: 1101年，他在常州去世。

shots.description: The name 东坡居士 again, now with ink bleeding outward and a large seal
shots.motion: ink blooms beats 0-4; seal on beat 5

en.text: From exile to exile, he kept the name Dongpo.

zh-CN.text: 一贬再贬，他把苦日子，过成了东坡。

shots.description: Dawn on the misty river; the boat is empty, wide negative space
shots.motion: slow pull-out; mist thickens

en.text: Courtesy name Zizhan, art name Dongpo Jushi.

zh-CN.text: 他字子瞻，号东坡居士。

shots.description: Mist fills the frame for the end card
shots.motion: mist rises until the paper is almost blank

en.text: Could you turn exile into poetry?

zh-CN.text: 如果是你，还能把日子过成诗吗？
